';
/* EAL Next-Generation Additive Systems v3.1 | story mechanics and world-state */
(function(){
'use strict';
const IS_TOWN=GAME.id==='town';
const VERSION='3.2.0-interaction';
const TASKS=IS_TOWN?
 [
  {id:'gate',ch:0,scene:1,title:'MEASURE THE GATE',short:'Read the entrance measurements. File a repair order.',icon:'▥'},
  {id:'pump',ch:1,scene:4,title:'OPERATE PUMP SIX',short:'Test the inlet and pump, then file a cautious safety order.',icon:'◉'},
  {id:'skills',ch:2,scene:5,title:'MAKE THE LAMP WORK',short:'Build a working circuit and teach someone to repeat it.',icon:'✦'}
 ]:[
  {id:'clock',ch:0,scene:2,title:'SYNCHRONIZE THE CLOCKS',short:'Reconcile the time displays without naming a suspect.',icon:'◷'},
  {id:'photo',ch:1,scene:3,title:'RECOVER THE ORIGINAL',short:'Compare dates and issue a traceable caption correction.',icon:'▣'}
 ];
const LEX=IS_TOWN?
 [['accessible','无障碍可进入的'],['measurement','测量结果'],['passive voice','被动语态'],['maintenance','维护'],['empower','赋能；使有能力'],['evidence','证据']]:
 [['timestamp','时间戳'],['synchronize','同步'],['deduction','推断'],['provenance','来源记录'],['claim','说法；主张'],['deception','欺骗']];
function ensure(){
 if(!S.ng||typeof S.ng!=='object'||!S.ng.actions)S.ng={version:VERSION,actions:{},inputs:{},events:[],hint:{},followups:{}};
 for(const k of ['actions','inputs','hint','followups'])if(!S.ng[k]||typeof S.ng[k]!=='object')S.ng[k]={};
 if(!Array.isArray(S.ng.events))S.ng.events=[];
 S.ng.version=VERSION;
 return S.ng;
}
function q(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
function isDone(task){return !!ensure().actions[task];}
function task(){return TASKS.find(t=>t.ch===S.chapter);}
function snapshot(id){return ensure().inputs[id] || {};}
function update(id,key,val){const n=ensure();n.inputs[id]=n.inputs[id]||{};n.inputs[id][key]=val;persist();}
function record(id,data){const n=ensure();if(!n.actions[id]){n.actions[id]={...data,completedAt:new Date().toISOString()};n.events.push({chapter:S.chapter,scene:S.currentScene,action:id,...data});logEvent('NEXT-GEN FIELD ACTION / '+id+' / '+JSON.stringify(data));}persist();}
function htmlGloss(){return `<div class="ng-notes">${LEX.map(([a,b])=>`<span class="ng-gloss">${esc(a)} · ${esc(b)}</span>`).join('')}</div>`;}
function feedback(text,good=false){const e=q('ng-feedback');if(e){e.textContent=text;e.classList.toggle('success',good);}else toast(text);}
function choiceButtons(id,key,arr,selected){return `<div class="ng-hardware">${arr.map(([val,label])=>`<button type="button" class="${selected===val?'selected':''}" onclick="ngSet('${id}','${key}','${val}')">${esc(label)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;}
function saveDraft(id){const t=q('ng-writing');if(t)update(id,'writing',t.value);}
function noteFrame(s){return `<div class="ng-frame">${esc(s)}</div>`;}
function head(title,brief,tag){return `<div class="ng-head"><div><small class="label">${esc(tag)} / PHYSICAL EVIDENCE TASK</small><h2>${esc(title)}</h2><p class="ng-sub">${esc(brief)}</p></div><span class="ng-pulse-led ${isDone(tag.toLowerCase())?'on':''}"></span></div>`;}
function gearSVG(type,mode){
 if(type==='gate')return `<svg viewBox="0 0 480 226" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Adjustable metal gate and measured clearance"><defs><linearGradient id="iron" x1="0" x2="1"><stop stop-color="#2b505a"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#9fa9a5"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#27434a"/></linearGradient></defs><rect x="10" y="18" width="460" height="190" rx="5" fill="#101d24" stroke="#777d7b" stroke-width="6"/><g stroke="url(#iron)" stroke-width="9">${Array.from({length:13},(_,i)=>`<line x1="${24+i*36}" y1="19" x2="${24+i*36}" y2="197"/>`).join('')}</g><rect x="179" y="22" width="${mode==='90'?'145':mode==='75'?'113':'96'}" height="176" fill="#132b28" stroke="#e6b677" stroke-width="3"/><text x="240" y="116" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" fill="#ebd7a9" font-weight="bold">${esc(mode)} cm</text><line x1="170" y1="208" x2="309" y2="208" stroke="#d1c4a1" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/></svg>`;
 if(type==='pump')return `<svg viewBox="0 0 470 210" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Pump control pipe diagram"><rect width="470" height="210" rx="10" fill="#0b1a25"/><path d="M15 104 H157 Q205 104 205 142 H289 Q335 142 335 104 H455" stroke="#5b8398" stroke-width="26" fill="none"/><path d="M14 104 H157 Q205 104 205 142 H289 Q335 142 335 104 H455" stroke="${mode==='safe'?'#64d8c0':'#2b718f'}" stroke-width="12" fill="none" stroke-dasharray="28 14"/><rect x="142" y="55" width="56" height="98" rx="9" fill="#263d47" stroke="#9aafaf" stroke-width="4"/><circle cx="170" cy="104" r="21" stroke="#f2c795" stroke-width="7" fill="${mode==='safe'?'#5cae82':'#8e3e35'}"/><circle cx="345" cy="106" r="26" stroke="#d9aa6d" stroke-width="7" fill="${mode==='safe'?'#3f8c80':'#9a4739'}"/><text x="171" y="36" text-anchor="middle" fill="#eee0c3" font-size="18">INLET</text><text x="345" y="46" text-anchor="middle" fill="#eee0c3" font-size="18">PUMP</text></svg>`;
 if(type==='skills')return `<svg viewBox="0 0 460 210" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Solar lamp wiring and power indicator"><rect width="460" height="210" fill="#0b1922"/><g fill="none" stroke="#91acb4" stroke-width="7"><rect x="20" y="55" width="99" height="100" rx="4"/><rect x="181" y="83" width="93" height="75" rx="8"/><path d="M355 107 Q388 42 416 107"/></g><path d="M119 104 H181 M274 120 H355" stroke="${mode==='lit'?'#e6b55a':'#4d5859'}" stroke-width="8" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/><circle cx="385" cy="119" r="27" fill="${mode==='lit'?'#ffd678':'#38494e'}" stroke="#ad987a" stroke-width="7"/>${mode==='lit'?'<circle cx="385" cy="119" r="42" fill="none" stroke="#ffd678" opacity=".35" stroke-width="5"/>':''}<g fill="#d7e5db" font-size="17"><text x="34" y="37">PANEL</text><text x="184" y="67">BATTERY</text><text x="363" y="35">LAMP</text></g></svg>`;
 return '';
}
function renderGate(){
 const x=snapshot('gate'),w=x.width||'65',done=isDone('gate');
 return `${head('The ribbon nobody cut','An entrance was installed. The inspection describes who can actually use it.','ACCESS INSPECTION')}
 <div class="ng-deck v32-task-layout"><div class="ng-instrument v32-photo-workbench">
  <figure class="v32-site-photo"><img src="${asset('town_1.webp')}" alt="Original photographic view of the community garden gate, measured in the inspection"><figcaption><span>FIELD PHOTO / ENTRANCE A</span><span>07:42 · TODAY</span></figcaption></figure>
  <div class="v32-hardware-paper">
   <div class="v32-paper-title">FACILITIES TEAM · INSPECTION 07</div>
   <div class="v32-rule"></div>
   <div class="v32-measurements"><div><small>EXISTING GATE</small><strong>65<span> cm</span></strong></div><div><small>MEASURED CHAIR</small><strong>75<span> cm</span></strong></div></div>
   <p class="v32-paper-sub">No alternative entrance was recorded. Select a proposed opening; the proposed dimensions are not proof that repairs have happened.</p>
   <div class="v32-real-world-note">THE PHYSICAL PROBLEM: the recorded gate is 10 cm narrower than the chair.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="ng-choicebox v32-design-order"><h4>MARK THE REPLACEMENT SIZE IN THE WORK ORDER</h4>${choiceButtons('gate','width',[['65','65 cm · keep the barrier'],['75','75 cm · equal to the chair'],['90','90 cm · proposed wider entrance']],w)}
  <div class="v32-receipt"><span>DESIGN REVISION</span><b>${esc(w)} cm</b><small>${w==='90'?'CLEARANCE PROPOSED — NOT YET BUILT':w==='75'?'NO EXTRA CLEARANCE — RECONSIDER':'CURRENT OBSTRUCTION REMAINS'}</small></div>
  </div>${noteFrame('A new gate was installed, but it is only 65 cm wide. According to the inspection, the wheelchair is 75 cm wide. Perhaps we could ...')}</div>
 <div class="ng-form v32-authorisation"><small class="label">COUNCIL / WORK ORDER 07</small><h3>Tell the repair crew exactly what must change.</h3>
 <label for="ng-source">Attach a source the crew can verify</label><select id="ng-source"><option value="gate" ${x.source==='gate'?'selected':''}>GATE MEASUREMENT · 07:42</option><option value="notice" ${x.source==='notice'?'selected':''}>PUBLIC OPENING NOTICE · PROMOTIONAL CLAIM</option></select>
 <label for="ng-writing">Complete the order using a passive sentence, measured evidence and a recommendation.</label>
 <textarea id="ng-writing" ${done?'readonly':''} placeholder="The 65 cm gate was installed, but the measured wheelchair is 75 cm wide. We should ... because ...">${esc(x.writing||'')}</textarea>
 <div class="ng-tools"><button class="submit" onclick="ngSubmit('gate')" ${done?'disabled':''}>${done?'✓ WORK ORDER SIGNED':'SIGN AND FILE WORK ORDER'}</button><button onclick="ngHint('gate')">HINT</button></div>
 <div id="ng-feedback" class="ng-feedback ${done?'success':''}">${done?'The proposed 90 cm design is filed. The gate remains unchanged until the council funds the work.':'The council will not authorize this request without accurate evidence and a specific recommendation.'}</div>${htmlGloss()}</div></div>`;
}
function renderPump(){
 const x=snapshot('pump'),inlet=x.inlet||'closed',motor=x.motor||'off',safe=inlet==='open'&&motor==='on',done=isDone('pump');
 return `${head('The river does not follow a brochure','Inspect the actual riverbank, test two pump controls, and write a cautious safety order.','RIVER SAFETY')}
 <div class="ng-deck v32-task-layout"><div class="ng-instrument v32-photo-workbench">
 <figure class="v32-site-photo v32-river-photo"><img src="${asset('town_2.webp')}" alt="Photographic view of the real riverbank, high water and the metal footbridge"><figcaption><span>RIVERBANK MONITOR / CAMERA 02</span><span>LIVE MODEL · NOT A FORECAST</span></figcaption></figure>
 <div class="v32-pump-status ${safe?'safe':'risk'}"><div><small>SIMULATED WATER ROUTE</small><strong>${safe?'DIVERTING FROM LOW STREET':'WATER RISING'}</strong></div><div class="v32-signalbar" aria-label="Simulated drainage status"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div></div>
 <div class="v32-controls"><div class="ng-choicebox"><h4>CONTROL 01 / NORTH INLET</h4>${choiceButtons('pump','inlet',[['closed','CLOSED'],['open','OPEN']],inlet)}</div><div class="ng-choicebox"><h4>CONTROL 02 / BYPASS PUMP</h4>${choiceButtons('pump','motor',[['off','OFF'],['on','ON']],motor)}</div></div>
 <div class="v32-sensor-note">MAINTENANCE LOG · Pump disabled for <b>40 minutes</b> during opening ceremony. No named operator. The model does not verify future flood reduction.</div>
 ${noteFrame('A concrete wall was built. The pump was disabled for forty minutes. According to the maintenance record, we should ... because ...')}</div>
 <div class="ng-form v32-authorisation"><small class="label">ENGINEER'S SIGNED TEST / PUMP SIX</small><h3>A test is not a safety certificate.</h3>
 <label for="ng-writing">Write a maintenance order. Use the passive voice, an exact source and a cautious recommendation.</label>
 <textarea id="ng-writing" ${done?'readonly':''} placeholder="The pump was disabled for forty minutes, according to the maintenance record. We should ... because ...">${esc(x.writing||'')}</textarea>
 <div class="ng-tools"><button class="submit" onclick="ngSubmit('pump')" ${done?'disabled':''}>${done?'✓ TEST LOGGED':'TEST AND FILE ORDER'}</button><button onclick="ngHint('pump')">HINT</button></div>
 <div id="ng-feedback" class="ng-feedback ${done?'success':''}">${done?'The controlled drainage test is logged. Water levels must still be monitored outside the simulation.':'Test each setting. Do not claim that a simulated improvement proves the wall has ended flooding.'}</div>${htmlGloss()}</div></div>`;
}
function renderSkills(){
 const x=snapshot('skills'),wires=Array.isArray(x.wires)?x.wires:[],done=isDone('skills'),connected=wires.length===3;
 return `${head('Twelve lamps. No one can repair them.','The trainer is gone. Reconstruct a working kit, then pass the skill on without depending on the trainer.','SKILL TRANSFER')}
 <div class="ng-deck v32-task-layout"><div class="ng-instrument v32-tool-kit">
  <div class="v32-kit-head"><span>VILLAGE TRAINING KIT · BOX 03</span><span>${connected?'OUTPUT VERIFIED':'AWAITING CONNECTION'}</span></div>
  <div class="v32-parts"><div class="v32-part ${wires.includes('panel')?'used':''}"><span class="v32-part-symbol">▦</span><b>SOLAR PANEL</b><small>INPUT / ENERGY</small></div><div class="v32-part ${wires.includes('battery')?'used':''}"><span class="v32-part-symbol">▰</span><b>BATTERY</b><small>STORE / ENERGY</small></div><div class="v32-part ${connected?'glowing':''}"><span class="v32-part-symbol">◉</span><b>LAMP</b><small>OUTPUT / LIGHT</small></div></div>
  <div class="v32-cable"><span>POWER ROUTE</span><b>${esc(wires.join(' → ')||'NO WIRES CONNECTED')}</b><span>${connected?'A learner can test the connected kit':'Connect one part at a time'}</span></div>
  <div class="ng-choicebox"><h4>CONNECT THE REAL COMPONENTS IN ORDER</h4><div class="ng-hardware">${[['panel','SOLAR PANEL'],['battery','BATTERY'],['lamp','LAMP']].map(([v,l])=>`<button class="${wires.includes(v)?'selected':''}" onclick="ngWire('${v}')" ${done?'disabled':''}>${esc(l)}</button>`).join('')}</div><button class="btn slim ghost" onclick="ngResetWires()" ${done?'disabled':''}>UNPLUG AND TRY AGAIN</button></div>
  ${noteFrame('First, connect the panel to the battery. Next, connect the lamp. Finally, demonstrate the repair to another volunteer.')}
 </div><div class="ng-form v32-authorisation"><small class="label">VILLAGE VOLUNTEER / TRAINING RECORD</small><h3>Can a second person repeat this?</h3>
 <p class="v32-evidence-notice">Training is not proved by the number of lamps delivered or certificates printed. The learner must explain and demonstrate the steps.</p>
 <label for="ng-writing">Give clear instructions and explain how the volunteers will independently maintain the lamps.</label>
 <textarea id="ng-writing" ${done?'readonly':''} placeholder="First, connect the panel to the battery. Next, test the lamp. Volunteers should learn to repair it because ...">${esc(x.writing||'')}</textarea>
 <div class="ng-tools"><button class="submit" onclick="ngSubmit('skills')" ${done?'disabled':''}>${done?'✓ TEACH-BACK FILED':'TEST AND TEACH BACK'}</button><button onclick="ngHint('skills')">HINT</button></div>
 <div id="ng-feedback" class="ng-feedback ${done?'success':''}">${done?'The circuit was demonstrated and the process recorded. The next learner can now practise independently.':'A wired lamp alone does not show that anyone learned the skill.'}</div>${htmlGloss()}</div></div>`;
}
function renderClock(){const x=snapshot('clock'),n=Number(x.offset||0),t=(136-n).toString(),seen=isDone('clock');const pad2=(v)=>String(v).padStart(2,'0');return `${head('A voice match is not an identity.','The camera appears two minutes ahead of the door clock. Calibrate the recorded times before concluding who entered.','CLOCK')}<div class="ng-deck"><div class="ng-instrument"><div class="ng-metal"><div class="ng-timeline"><div><small>DOOR / ACTUAL CLOCK</small><b>02:14</b></div><div><small>CAMERA / DISPLAYED</small><b>02:16</b></div></div><div class="ng-sourceclip">EDITED ACCESS LOG: 02:16<br>CAMERA RUNS AHEAD: +02:00<br>The log does not identify the editor.</div><div class="ng-dial ${n===2?'':'amber'}">CAMERA CORRECTED: 02:${pad2(16-n)}</div></div><label for="ng-offset" style="display:block;margin:15px 0 5px">Subtract the camera's offset: <b>${n} minutes</b></label><input style="width:100%" id="ng-offset" type="range" min="0" max="4" step="1" value="${n}" oninput="ngRange('clock','offset',this.value)"><p class="ng-caption">Clock alignment can explain conflicting times. It cannot prove that Noor lied or that any voice recording is authentic.</p>${noteFrame('The camera might have been ahead by two minutes. However, the record does not prove who edited the log.')}</div><div class="ng-form"><small class="label">FORENSIC TECHNICIAN / SIGNED NOTE</small><label for="ng-claim">Which conclusion is defensible?</label><select id="ng-claim"><option value="drift" ${x.claim==='drift'?'selected':''}>A clock difference might explain the discrepancy.</option><option value="guilt" ${x.claim==='guilt'?'selected':''}>Noor must have edited the log.</option><option value="clone" ${x.claim==='clone'?'selected':''}>The voice recording definitely proves the speaker.</option></select><label for="ng-writing">Write a cautious deduction with an exact time from the evidence.</label><textarea id="ng-writing" ${seen?'readonly':''} placeholder="The camera might have been two minutes ahead of the door clock. According to the log, it was edited at 02:16, but we cannot identify who changed it.">${esc(x.writing||'')}</textarea><div class="ng-tools"><button class="submit" onclick="ngSubmit('clock')" ${seen?'disabled':''}>${seen?'✓ CLOCKS SYNCHRONIZED':'PRESERVE CALIBRATION NOTE'}</button><button onclick="ngHint('clock')">HINT</button></div><div id="ng-feedback" class="ng-feedback ${seen?'success':''}">${seen?'Two clocks now agree in the forensic display. The original versions remain protected. No suspect has been identified.':'Move the offset until both time displays agree; keep your claims proportional to the evidence.'}</div>${htmlGloss()}</div></div>`;}
function renderPhoto(){const x=snapshot('photo'),day=x.day||'friday',shown=Number(x.reveal??20),done=isDone('photo');return `${head('One metadata file. One misleading caption.','Recover the original Thursday timestamp, compare it with the Friday repost, then issue a traceable correction.','PHOTO')}<div class="ng-deck"><div class="ng-instrument"><div class="ng-metal" style="padding:8px"><div class="ng-scan-pair"><figure><img id="ng-meta-scan" src="${evidenceProp(3,1)}" alt="Physical photo metadata display with original Thursday timestamp" style="filter:brightness(${.5+shown/200}) blur(${Math.max(0,((100-shown)/32)).toFixed(1)}px)"><figcaption>01 / CAMERA METADATA · PRIMARY EVIDENCE</figcaption></figure><figure><img src="${evidenceProp(3,2)}" alt="Preserved photographic archive document naming the original and later claims"><figcaption>02 / PUBLIC CLAIM · ARCHIVE COPY</figcaption></figure></div></div><label for="ng-reveal" style="display:block;margin-top:14px">DEVELOP ORIGINAL SCAN — <b id="ng-scan-value">${shown}%</b></label><input style="width:100%" id="ng-reveal" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="${shown}" oninput="ngRange('photo','reveal',this.value)"><p class="ng-caption">Reveal at least 75% of the archived metadata. This is a display adjustment, not alteration of the original file.</p><div class="ng-timeline"><div><small>ORIGINAL METADATA</small><b style="font-size:1.5rem">THU</b></div><div><small>VIRAL CAPTION</small><b style="font-size:1.5rem">FRI</b></div></div><div class="ng-choicebox"><h4>DATE SUPPORTED BY THE ORIGINAL FILE</h4>${choiceButtons('photo','day',[['thursday','THURSDAY'],['friday','FRIDAY']],day)}</div>${noteFrame('The original file must have been recorded on Thursday. It cannot have shown a Friday event. The writer’s motive is still unknown.')}</div><div class="ng-form"><small class="label">PUBLICATION / CORRECTION SLIP</small><label for="ng-writing">Write a defensible correction using a past deduction (must have, might have, cannot have) and the original file as your source.</label><textarea id="ng-writing" ${done?'readonly':''} placeholder="According to the original file, the photo must have been recorded on Thursday. It cannot have shown a Friday event, but we do not know why the caption changed.">${esc(x.writing||'')}</textarea><div class="ng-tools"><button class="submit" onclick="ngSubmit('photo')" ${done?'disabled':''}>${done?'✓ SOURCE FILED':'ISSUE DATED CORRECTION'}</button><button onclick="ngHint('photo')">HINT</button></div><div id="ng-feedback" class="ng-feedback ${done?'success':''}">${done?'The original is linked to the correction. Later news screens will refer to the dated source.':'The original date and published caption must be compared before a correction is transmitted.'}</div>${htmlGloss()}</div></div>`;}
function support(id){const data={gate:['The ___ was installed, but the measured ___ is ___ cm. We should ___ because ___.','Explain why access width and opening hours are separate design problems.'],pump:['According to the maintenance record, the pump was ___. We should ___, but further ___ is needed.','Distinguish a modeled drainage result from long-term flood safety evidence.'],skills:['First, ___. Next, ___. A volunteer could repeat this because ___.','Design a teach-back test that distinguishes understanding from copying.'],clock:['The camera might have ___ because the clock shows ___. However, we cannot conclude ___.','Explain why agreement between two corrected times does not establish who edited an access log.'],photo:['According to the original file, the image must have ___. It cannot have ___.','Write a correction which preserves uncertainty about the author’s intentions.']}[id];return `<div class="ng-scaffold"><div><b>CORE · SENTENCE FRAME</b><p>${esc(data[0])}</p></div><details><summary>STRETCH · GO FURTHER</summary><p>${esc(data[1])}</p></details></div>`;}
function open(id){ensure();const t=TASKS.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!t){return;}if(S.chapter<t.ch){toast('This system is not accessible yet.');return;}const body=`<div class="ng-modal">${id==='gate'?renderGate():id==='pump'?renderPump():id==='skills'?renderSkills():id==='clock'?renderClock():renderPhoto()}${support(id)}<div class="ng-original-nav">FIELD CASE ${pad(t.ch)} · ${esc(t.title)} · Your work is saved in this offline browser and included in teacher exports.</div></div>`;openModal(body,'FIELD SYSTEM / '+t.title);}
function set(id,key,val){if(isDone(id))return;saveDraft(id);update(id,key,val);open(id);}
function range(id,key,val){if(isDone(id))return;update(id,key,val);const n=Number(val),x=snapshot(id);if(id==='photo'){const im=q('ng-meta-scan'),s=q('ng-scan-value');if(im)im.style.filter=`brightness(${.5+n/200}) blur(${Math.max(0,(100-n)/32).toFixed(1)}px)`;if(s)s.textContent=n+'%';}if(id==='clock'){const d=q('modalBody');if(d){const el=d.querySelector('.ng-dial');if(el){el.textContent='CAMERA CORRECTED: 02:'+String(16-n).padStart(2,'0');el.classList.toggle('amber',n!==2);}const label=d.querySelector('label[for=ng-offset] b');if(label)label.textContent=n+' minutes';}}}
function wire(v){if(isDone('skills'))return;const x=snapshot('skills'),a=Array.isArray(x.wires)?[...x.wires]:[];const expected=['panel','battery','lamp'];if(a.includes(v)){feedback('This component is already connected.');return;}if(v!==expected[a.length]){feedback('That wire cannot be attached yet. Check which part supplies power first.');return;}a.push(v);update('skills','wires',a);open('skills');}
function resetWires(){update('skills','wires',[]);open('skills');}
function hint(id){ensure();const h=S.ng.hint[id]||0;S.ng.hint[id]=Math.min(2,h+1);persist();const a={gate:['Compare 65 cm with the measured 75 cm chair.','Select 90 cm. Cite GATE MEASUREMENT, use “was installed” and propose a change.'],pump:['Test both physical controls. Neither a new wall nor a brochure proves that the area is safe.','Open the inlet, turn on the bypass pump, and write a cautious maintenance order with a source.'],skills:['Follow the direction energy flows: solar panel to battery to lamp.','Connect PANEL → BATTERY → LAMP. Explain how a volunteer will repeat the repair.'],clock:['The camera time is later than the door time by a small amount.','Subtract two minutes from 02:16, then make a cautious claim with “might have” and a cited log.'],photo:['Trust original dated metadata before later public captions.','Choose Thursday. Write “must have been”, “cannot have been”, and cite the original file.']}[id];feedback(a[Math.min(h,a.length-1)]);}
function has(t,re){return re.test(String(t||''));}
function validate(id){const x=snapshot(id),text=String(q('ng-writing')?.value||x.writing||'').trim();if(q('ng-writing'))update(id,'writing',text);
 if(isDone(id))return {ok:true};
 if(text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length<17)return {ok:false,message:'Explain the evidence and recommended action in at least 17 words. This is a real record, not a code word.'};
 if(id==='gate'){
  if(x.width!=='90')return {ok:false,message:'The selected opening needs clearance beyond the measured 75 cm chair. Test the wider option.'};
  if(q('ng-source')?.value!=='gate')return {ok:false,message:'Attach the measurement, not a general promotional notice.'};
  update(id,'source','gate');
  if(!has(text,/\b65\b/)||!has(text,/\b75\b/))return {ok:false,message:'Cite both the 65 cm entrance and 75 cm chair measurements.'};
  if(!has(text,/\b(was|were|has been|have been|is|are)\s+(installed|built|constructed|repaired|widened|placed|changed)\b/i))return {ok:false,message:'Use a passive construction to describe a completed change, such as “was installed”.'};
  if(!has(text,/\b(should|could|recommend|suggest|propose|need)\b/i))return {ok:false,message:'Make an actionable recommendation.'};
 }
 if(id==='pump'){
  if(!(x.inlet==='open'&&x.motor==='on'))return {ok:false,message:'The simulated water is still rising. Revise the inlet and pump settings.'};
  if(!has(text,/\bpump\b/i)||!has(text,/\b(was|were|has been|have been|is|are)\s+(disabled|stopped|inspected|repaired|tested|activated|installed|built)\b/i))return {ok:false,message:'Name the pump and describe a verified or proposed operation in the passive voice.'};
  if(!has(text,/\b(according|record|inspection|report|evidence)\b/i)||!has(text,/\b(should|could|recommend|suggest|need|propose)\b/i))return {ok:false,message:'Cite a record and recommend a cautious action. A simulation alone is not proof of safety.'};
 }
 if(id==='skills'){
  if(JSON.stringify(x.wires||[])!==JSON.stringify(['panel','battery','lamp']))return {ok:false,message:'The circuit does not yet connect all three components in the correct order.'};
  if(!has(text,/\b(first|begin|start|initially)\b/i)||!has(text,/\b(next|then|finally|after)\b/i)||!has(text,/\b(teach|train|learn|volunteer|repair|demonstrate|explain)\b/i))return {ok:false,message:'Give two ordered steps and explain how another person can learn to repair the lamp.'};
 }
 if(id==='clock'){
  if(String(x.offset||'0')!=='2')return {ok:false,message:'Camera and door times are not aligned. Recalculate the minute difference.'};
  if(q('ng-claim')?.value!=='drift')return {ok:false,message:'The evidence supports a time discrepancy, not a definite suspect or a verified voice identity.'};
  update(id,'claim','drift');
  if(!has(text,/\b(might|may|could|must|can.?t|cannot)\b/i)||!has(text,/\b(02:14|02:16|two minutes|2 minutes)\b/i)||!has(text,/\b(log|record|camera|door|evidence|according)\b/i))return {ok:false,message:'Use a cautious modal deduction, an exact time or offset, and identify the source.'};
 }
 if(id==='photo'){
  if(Number(x.reveal??0)<75)return {ok:false,message:'Develop at least 75% of the archived metadata before filing the correction.'};
  if(x.day!=='thursday')return {ok:false,message:'The original photographic metadata identifies Thursday, not the Friday of the repost.'};
  if(!has(text,/\b(must|might|could|can.?t|cannot)\s+have\b/i)||!has(text,/\b(thursday)\b/i)||!has(text,/\b(file|metadata|original|photograph|archive|source|record)\b/i))return {ok:false,message:'Use “must/might/cannot have”, Thursday, and cite original evidence.'};
  if(has(text,/\b(proves?|definitely|certainly)\s+(that\s+)?(the editor|the writer|the speaker)\b/i))return {ok:false,message:'The image does not establish a writer’s intentions. Limit the claim.'};
 }
 return {ok:true,writing:text};
}
function submit(id){const result=validate(id);if(!result.ok){feedback(result.message);playFx('error');return;}record(id,{writing:result.writing,inputs:snapshot(id)});if(id==='gate')statChange({trust:2,evidence:2});if(id==='pump')statChange({safety:4,evidence:2});if(id==='skills')statChange({trust:3});if(id==='clock')statChange({credibility:4,privacy:2,alarm:-2});if(id==='photo')statChange({credibility:4,alarm:-3});persist();playFx('success');render();open(id);}
function worldState(){
 if(IS_TOWN){
  const c=S.currentScene;if(c===1)return {kind:isDone('gate')?'good':'warning',label:isDone('gate')?'MEASUREMENT FILED':'ACCESS PROBLEM',text:isDone('gate')?'90 cm opening proposed. The old gate remains until the council funds work.':'65 cm entrance vs 75 cm measured chair. The gate remains inaccessible.',beam:''};
  if(c===2||c===4){const safe=isDone('pump');const risky=S.decisions[1]==='brochure';return {kind:safe?'good':'warning',label:safe?'PUMP TEST DOCUMENTED':'RIVER SAFETY UNVERIFIED',text:safe?'A drainage configuration was tested. The town still needs live flood data.':risky?'Tourist notices hide the flood caution; water remains high.':'The safety claim remains unverified. Pump Six is under review.',beam:safe?'clear':'flood'};}
  if(c===5||c===6)return {kind:isDone('skills')?'good':'warning',label:isDone('skills')?'REPAIR SKILL TRANSFERRED':'LAMP TRAINING INCOMPLETE',text:isDone('skills')?'A village volunteer can rebuild the working lamp without the trainer.':'Twelve lamps were delivered. Independent repair was not demonstrated.',beam:''};
  if(c===7||c===8||c===9){const budget=S.puzzleState[3]||[];const done=S.decisions[3];return {kind:done?'good':'warning',label:done?'COUNCIL ACTION ON RECORD':'COUNCIL DECISION PENDING',text:done?`Funded: ${budget.join(' & ')||'not recorded'}. Unfunded needs remain in the public report.`:`The town's previous decisions are visible in its public repair ledger.`,beam:''};}
  return {kind:'warning',label:'UNFINISHED CIVIC WORK',text:S.decisions[0]==='hours'?'Evening access is under review. The narrower gate still needs a measurement-based repair.':'A new notice covers the old memorial. Residents are asking for evidence of benefit.',beam:''};
 }else{
  const c=S.currentScene;
  if(c===0||c===1||c===2){const accused=S.decisions[0]==='accuse';const done=isDone('clock');return {kind:accused?'warning':done?'good':'warning',label:accused?'SECURITY ARCHIVE SEALED':done?'TIME ALIGNMENT RECORDED':'CLOCKS OUT OF SYNC',text:accused?'A public accusation triggered an archive restriction. Copies of the log still remain in the case file.':done?'The clock offset was corrected. The editor remains unidentified.':'Camera shows 02:16; door shows 02:14. The mismatch requires calibration.',beam:accused?'blackout':''};}
  if(c===3||c===4){const blocked=S.decisions[1]==='delete';return {kind:isDone('photo')&&!blocked?'good':'warning',label:blocked?'PUBLIC PHOTO REMOVED':isDone('photo')?'ORIGINAL PHOTO PRESERVED':'CAPTION DISPUTED',text:blocked?'The post vanished. The archived original remains accessible to investigators.':isDone('photo')?'Thursday metadata contradicts the Friday headline. The correction keeps both versions.':'The viral caption says Friday; the original was recorded on Thursday.',beam:blocked?'blackout':'corrected'};}
  if(c===7||c===8||c===9){const last=S.decisions[3];return {kind:last==='publish'?'good':'warning',label:last==='publish'?'CORRECTION BROADCAST':last==='delay'?'PUBLIC WARNING DELAYED':last==='shame'?'ACCUSATION SPREADING':'TRANSMISSION PENDING',text:last==='publish'?'Families received 3:30, North Gate, with the official notice attached.':last==='delay'?'The bus schedule remained wrong while the announcement waited.':last==='shame'?'The departure time was corrected, but a name was accused without proof.':'The official bus notice says 3:30, North Gate.',beam:last==='shame'?'blackout':''};}
  return {kind:'warning',label:'APPLICATION UNDER REVIEW',text:S.decisions[2]==='stretched'?'The false résumé passed an early screen; a verification flag follows it.':'The applicant’s documented contributions are being compared.',beam:''};
 }
}
/* Choice-specific, in-world records: evidence changes across later chapters. These are original narrative extensions, not textbook quotations. */
const BRANCH_FILES=IS_TOWN?{
  1:{gate:{title:'ACCESSIBILITY SURVEY FOLLOW-UP',kind:'Resident inspection',author:'Eli, Garden Committee',lines:['The council requested entrance measurements after a resident reported difficulty entering.','The original gate still measures 65 cm, and the observed wheelchair measures 75 cm.','A wider design has been proposed but has not yet been funded.']},hours:{title:'SHIFT WORKERS SERVICE PETITION',kind:'Petition',author:'Maya and six workshop workers',lines:['Six workers report that the garden closes before their shifts finish.','The council is reviewing two evening-opening sessions.','The gate still measures 65 cm; extending hours does not change access width.']},signs:{title:'CHILDREN’S SIGN DESIGN NOTE',kind:'Design proposal',author:'Junior Design Team',lines:['The children have drawn signs that can be read from a lower height.','No construction order was issued for the entrance itself.','The committee still needs to review the reported gate-width problem.']}},
  2:{precise:{title:'MUSEUM LIMITATIONS CAPTION',kind:'Curatorial note',author:'Municipal Image Archive',lines:['The display now describes the wall and walkways without claiming permanent flood protection.','The museum has not published new water-level measurements.','The pump has not been cleared for continuous operation.']},caution:{title:'RIVER SAFETY CAUTION RECORD',kind:'Safety advisory',author:'Ren, River Engineer',lines:['The new structure is documented, but no later flood measurement verifies a permanent reduction in risk.','The safety board now requests an independent pump test.','Residents may use the path while checking the posted river warning.']},brochure:{title:'RIVER MARKETING CONTRACT',kind:'Tourism copy',author:'Rivermere Visitors Office',lines:['The brochure’s claim that flooding stopped forever remains on display.','Tour operators have removed the uncertainty notice from their advertisements.','Residents report that the water warning is harder to find.']}},
  3:{certificates:{title:'TRAINING OUTCOME REVIEW',kind:'Education review',author:'Village Volunteer Network',lines:['Thirty certificates were printed, but independent repair ability was not demonstrated for every learner.','Broken lamps still require new skills and parts.','The council must decide how to measure practical learning.']},demonstrations:{title:'PEER DEMONSTRATION REGISTER',kind:'Workshop observation',author:'Workshop Trainer',lines:['Learners taught a second person how to test the lamp circuit.','The next village workshop can repeat the demonstration without the original trainer.','The council is asked to keep a record of who successfully repairs a lamp.']},repairs:{title:'MONTHLY REPAIR FOLLOW-UP',kind:'Maintenance log',author:'Village Relay Station',lines:['The program will count independently completed lamp repairs instead of certificates.','Several replacement parts remain in short supply.','The network requests a supply plan that residents can maintain themselves.']}}
}:{
  1:{checklog:{title:'PROTECTED ACCESS-LOG PAIR',kind:'Forensic exhibit',author:'Jules, Recording Office',lines:['Both the original and edited access records have been retained.','The second entry is marked 02:16; the door clock and camera may differ.','The records do not establish the identity of the editor.']},question:{title:'TWO SEPARATE INTERVIEWS',kind:'Witness memorandum',author:'Security Review Desk',lines:['Noor remembers leaving the corridor before the alarm.','Ben remembers hearing an alarm but did not see who edited the log.','Neither statement establishes who created the suspicious recording.']},accuse:{title:'PUBLIC LOBBY TRANSFER COPY',kind:'Redacted archive copy',author:'Aurora Security Office',lines:['An online accusation caused private access to be temporarily restricted.','Only a redacted lobby copy remains available at this counter.','The original access-log record is protected; the private editor identity is not established.']}},
  2:{edit:{title:'REVISED HEADLINE WITH PROVENANCE',kind:'Press correction',author:'Nina, Editing Desk',lines:['The headline now links the image to its Thursday original.','The newsroom acknowledges that the Friday caption was not supported.','The author’s motive has not been verified.']},delete:{title:'SCREENSHOT RUMOR THREAD',kind:'Community message',author:'Unverified message board',lines:['A copy of the deleted post has been reposted without a source link.','Some comments claim the deletion proves guilt.','No message identifies the original author with verified evidence.']},blame:{title:'EDITOR’S RESPONSE TO ACCUSATION',kind:'Statement',author:'Nina, Editing Desk',lines:['The unknown writer was accused publicly before the original file was reviewed.','Nina requests a source-based correction and a retraction of unsupported claims.','The camera date is Thursday; intent remains unverified.']}},
  3:{accurate:{title:'VERIFIED APPLICATION RESPONSE',kind:'Recruitment note',author:'Ms. Park, Recruiter',lines:['The applicant’s actual work was documented with two broadcasts, three pages, and team book-drive contributions.','A stronger statement is possible without making a false claim.','The interview remains open for discussion of those skills.']},reject:{title:'MISSED OPPORTUNITY MEMO',kind:'Recruitment note',author:'Ms. Park, Recruiter',lines:['The inaccurate statement was not accepted.','The applicant was rejected without considering the supported contributions.','The committee will review whether its verification process was fair.']},stretched:{title:'AUTOMATED SCREENING WARNING',kind:'Recruitment audit',author:'Aurora Recruitment System',lines:['An impressive résumé was sent before the evidence was checked.','The unsupported claims were flagged during verification.','The applicant may need to explain the difference between group work and personal responsibility.']}}
};
function branchDoc(ch){if(ch<1)return null;const key=S.decisions[ch-1];const item=BRANCH_FILES[ch]?.[key];if(!item)return null;return {id:`ng_branch_${ch}_${key}`,kind:item.kind,label:item.title,headline:item.title,author:item.author,date:'CASE DAY '+String(ch+1).padStart(2,'0'),format:'memo',lines:item.lines,required:true};}
function installBranchDocs(){for(let ch=1;ch<GAME.chapters.length;ch++){const C=GAME.chapters[ch];C.docs=C.docs.filter(d=>!String(d.id).startsWith('ng_branch_'));const d=branchDoc(ch);if(d)C.docs.push(d);}}
function physicalFixture(){const c=S.currentScene;
 if(IS_TOWN)return ''; // Avoid floating 2D gate/pump/lamp renders over photographic scenery.

 if(IS_TOWN){
  if(c===1){const budget=S.puzzleState?.[3]||[],built=!!S.decisions[3]&&budget.includes('gate');return `<svg class="ng-fixture ng-gate-fixture ${built?'operational':''}" viewBox="0 0 210 175" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="6" y="6" width="198" height="163" fill="#0a2027b3" stroke="#a2bbc0" stroke-width="6" rx="3"/><g stroke="#adc1bc" stroke-width="9"><path d="M20 12v146 M58 12v146 M96 12v146 M134 12v146 M172 12v146"/></g><path d="M64 16v145 M146 16v145" stroke="#d5b575" stroke-width="8"/><path d="M70 22h70v133H70Z" fill="#152f2a" opacity="${built?'.03':'.63'}" stroke="#f0d394" stroke-width="4"/><rect x="44" y="132" width="${built?140:94}" height="8" fill="${built?'#7de0a8':'#db9654'}"/></svg>`;}
  if(c===4){const fixed=isDone('pump');return `<svg class="ng-fixture ng-pump-fixture ${fixed?'operational':''}" viewBox="0 0 180 140" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 90h160" stroke="#416a76" stroke-width="35"/><path d="M8 90h160" stroke="${fixed?'#4bdec2':'#375980'}" stroke-width="15" stroke-dasharray="22 12"/><circle cx="88" cy="90" r="41" fill="#213e43" stroke="#b59166" stroke-width="12"/><circle cx="88" cy="90" r="27" fill="${fixed?'#2e8b6f':'#8b362f'}"/><path d="M88 65v50 M62 90h52" stroke="#d9bfa0" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="88" cy="90" r="8" fill="#182328"/></svg>`;}
  if(c===6){const lit=isDone('skills');return `<svg class="ng-fixture ng-lamp-fixture" viewBox="0 0 300 180" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 63C92 5 183 13 285 63" fill="none" stroke="#c6bdaa" stroke-width="4"/>${[40,95,150,205,260].map((x,i)=>`<g><path d="M${x} ${41+i%2*5} v24" stroke="#c3aa8b" stroke-width="5"/><circle cx="${x}" cy="75" r="${lit?22:14}" fill="${lit?'#ffe0a0':'#576367'}" opacity="${lit?'.38':'1'}"/><circle cx="${x}" cy="75" r="13" fill="${lit?'#fff0b0':'#546367'}"/></g>`).join('')}</svg>`;}
  return '';
 }
 if(c===1&&S.decisions[0]==='accuse')return `<div class="ng-fixture ng-security-shutter" aria-hidden="true"></div>`;
 if(c===4){const corrected=isDone('photo');return `<div class="ng-fixture ng-media-display ${corrected?'operational':''}" aria-hidden="true"><div class="ng-screen-led"></div><div class="ng-screen-line"></div><div class="ng-screen-line"></div><div class="ng-screen-line short"></div></div>`;}
 if(c===7||c===9){const m=S.decisions[3];return `<div class="ng-fixture ng-news-display ${m==='publish'?'operational':m==='shame'?'danger':''}" aria-hidden="true"><div class="ng-screen-led"></div><div class="ng-screen-line"></div><div class="ng-screen-line"></div><div class="ng-screen-line short"></div></div>`;}
 return '';
}
function sceneDecorate(){const viewport=document.querySelector('.viewport');if(!viewport)return;const state=worldState();if(S.view==='scene'){
 const s=document.createElement('div');s.className='ng-state-beam '+(state.beam||'');viewport.append(s);const fixture=physicalFixture();if(fixture)viewport.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',fixture);
 const prop=document.createElement('div');prop.className='ng-world-prop '+state.kind;prop.innerHTML=`<strong><span class="ng-pulse-led ${state.kind==='good'?'on':''}" style="margin-right:7px;width:9px;height:9px"></span> ${esc(state.label)}</strong><span>${esc(state.text)}</span>`;viewport.append(prop);
 const t=task();if(t && S.currentScene===t.scene){const action=document.createElement('button');action.className='ng-hotspot';action.title='Operate physical system';action.setAttribute('aria-label',t.title);action.innerHTML=`<span class="ng-icon">${t.icon}</span><span><strong>${esc(t.title)}</strong><small>${isDone(t.id)?'REOPEN COMPLETED RECORD':'INTERACT WITH EQUIPMENT'}</small></span>`;action.onclick=()=>open(t.id);viewport.append(action);}
 if((IS_TOWN&&S.currentScene===6&&isDone('skills'))||(!IS_TOWN&&S.currentScene===7&&isDone('photo'))){const c=document.createElement('div');c.className='ng-hero-ribbon';c.innerHTML=IS_TOWN?'<b>VILLAGE LIGHTS RESTORED</b><span>Volunteer repairs now possible</span>':'<b>ORIGINAL SOURCE LINKED</b><span>Thursday metadata preserved</span>';viewport.append(c);}
 const witness=returningWitness();if(witness){const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.className='ng-hotspot';btn.style.bottom='35%';btn.innerHTML=`<span class="ng-icon">◉</span><span><strong>${esc(witness.name)} RETURNS</strong><small>Hear a changed account</small></span>`;btn.onclick=()=>returningOpen();viewport.append(btn);}
 } else if(S.view==='map'){
  const nodes=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.node'));
  for(const t of TASKS){if(nodes[t.scene]&&S.unlockedChapter>=t.ch){const badge=document.createElement('small');badge.className='ng-map-flag';badge.textContent=isDone(t.id)?'✓ FIELD ACTION COMPLETE':'◎ FIELD ACTION';nodes[t.scene].append(badge);}}
 }
}
function returningWitness(){const c=S.currentScene;
 if(IS_TOWN&&c===7)return {name:'MARA',portrait:'town_npc_0.png',text:S.decisions[0]==='gate'?'You asked for the dimensions first. The repair plan now matches the wheelchair measurement.':'The repair may help some people, but the gate still excludes the measured chair. The council must record that.'};
 if(IS_TOWN&&c===6)return {name:'THE TRAINER',portrait:'town_npc_5.png',text:isDone('skills')?'The volunteers rebuilt the lamp without my help. Now our evidence is practical, not ceremonial.':'We gave out certificates, but I cannot prove that anyone can repair a lamp.'};
 if(!IS_TOWN&&c===7)return {name:'JULES',portrait:'voice_npc_0.png',text:S.decisions[0]==='accuse'?'My recording was spread as proof of Noor’s guilt. The source file still has not been verified.':'I kept the first waveform and the two clock readings. A match is not a signed identity.'};
 if(!IS_TOWN&&c===4)return {name:'ARI',portrait:'voice_npc_3.png',text:isDone('photo')?'You connected the correction to my Thursday original. That lets readers check the date.':'Please do not erase the source photograph. A denial without the file will only create another rumor.'};
 return null;
}
function returningOpen(){const w=returningWitness();if(!w)return;const msg=`<div class="ng-modal ng-deck"><div class="ng-instrument"><img class="ng-evidence-thumb" src="${asset(w.portrait)}" alt="Returning witness portrait"><small class="label">RETURNING CONTACT / RECORDED FOLLOW-UP</small><h2>${esc(w.name)}</h2></div><div class="ng-form"><h3>What changed after your earlier choices?</h3><blockquote>“${esc(w.text)}”</blockquote>${noteFrame('Compare this return testimony with the earlier source record. Decide which claims remain unproven.')}<button class="btn gold" onclick="closeModal()">KEEP INVESTIGATING</button></div></div>`;ensure().followups[w.name]=true;persist();logEvent('Returning witness interviewed / '+w.name);openModal(msg,w.name+' / FOLLOW-UP');}
function decorate(){ensure();document.documentElement.dataset.nextgen=VERSION;const v=document.querySelector('.pane');if(v){const t=task();if(t){const n=document.createElement('div');n.className='ng-mission-pill';n.innerHTML=`<div><small>PHYSICAL INTERVENTION · ${esc(GAME.chapters[t.ch].name)}</small><strong>${isDone(t.id)?'✓ '+t.title+' / Filed in the case record':t.title+' / '+t.short}</strong></div><button class="btn slim ${isDone(t.id)?'ghost':'gold'}" onclick="ngOpen('${t.id}')">${isDone(t.id)?'REVIEW':'OPERATE SYSTEM'}</button>`;v.prepend(n);}}
 sceneDecorate();
}
function missionCheck(){const t=task();return !t||isDone(t.id);}
const originalEndingText=endingText;
endingText=function(){const prior=originalEndingText();if(IS_TOWN){const test=isDone('pump')?'The Pump Six trial demonstrated a workable setting, but the river still needs real flood monitoring.':'The Pump Six risk remains unresolved without a documented safe trial.';return prior+' SYSTEM FINDING: HELIX optimized speed, cost and visitor numbers while leaving resident accessibility and flood-risk evidence out of its model. '+test;}
 return prior+' SOURCE FINDING: A waveform was copied from the voice-identification experiment. That explains how a recording could resemble the investigator without proving it was a live statement. Corrected clocks and the dated photograph limit false claims; the evidence still does not identify who edited the access log.';
};
const priorRender=render;render=function(){ensure();installBranchDocs();priorRender();decorate();};
const priorSubmit=submitWriting;submitWriting=function(){if(!missionCheck()){const t=task();toast('First complete the physical intervention '+t.title+'.');open(t.id);return;}return priorSubmit();};
const priorOpenNpc=openNpc;openNpc=function(sceneIndex){priorOpenNpc(sceneIndex); /* Existing witness interaction remains unchanged and fully navigable. */};
// Existing report is augmented, not replaced by a separate student submission.
exportReport=function(){ensure();let out=[GAME.title,'NEXT-GENERATION EDITION '+VERSION,'ENDING: '+endingName(),''];for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(GAME.statLabels))out.push(v+': '+S.stats[k]);out.push('');
 GAME.chapters.forEach((ch,i)=>{out.push('=== CHAPTER '+pad(i)+' '+ch.name+' ===');out.push('Decision: '+(ch.choice.options.find(o=>o.id===S.decisions[i])?.text||'—'));out.push('Consequence: '+(GAME.consequences[i][S.decisions[i]]||'—'));out.push('Cited sources: '+((S.cites[i]||[]).map(id=>GAME.chapters[i].docs.find(d=>d.id===id)?.label||id).join(' | ')));out.push('Original chapter writing:');out.push(S.writing[i]||S.draft[i]||'[not written]');const t=TASKS.find(x=>x.ch===i);if(t){out.push('Physical action: '+t.title+' / '+(isDone(t.id)?'COMPLETE':'NOT COMPLETE'));out.push('System settings: '+JSON.stringify(S.ng.inputs[t.id]||{}));out.push('Field writing: '+(S.ng.actions[t.id]?.writing||S.ng.inputs[t.id]?.writing||'[not written]'));}out.push('');});
 out.push('WORLD STATE & BRANCHES',JSON.stringify({decisions:S.decisions,systemActions:S.ng.actions,returningInterviews:S.ng.followups,conditionalRecords:GAME.chapters.map((c,i)=>c.docs.filter(d=>String(d.id).startsWith('ng_branch_')).map(d=>({chapter:i,title:d.label,read:!!S.docs[docKey(i,d.id)]})))},null,2));out.push('INVESTIGATION LOG');out.push(...S.logs);download(GAME.id+'_nextgen_field_report.txt',out.join('\n'));};
window.ngOpen=open;window.ngSet=set;window.ngRange=range;window.ngWire=wire;window.ngResetWires=resetWires;window.ngHint=hint;window.ngSubmit=submit;window.ngReturningOpen=returningOpen;window.__NG={ensure,isDone,validate,task,worldState,missionCheck,branchDoc,installBranchDocs,version:VERSION};
render();
})();

</script>
<script>/* v3.2 puzzle variety: four distinctly fictional tasks, original answer logic and curriculum retained. */
const v32PreviousPuzzleHTML=puzzleHTML;
function v32FileClaim(ch,i,val){setPuzzleValue(ch,i,val);render();}
puzzleHTML=function(){
 const ch=S.chapter,P=GAME.chapters[ch].puzzle,g=chapterGate(ch);
 if(!g.micro||S.puzzleSolved[ch])return v32PreviousPuzzleHTML();
 ensurePuzzleState(ch);
 const submit=`<div class="v32-puzzle-controls"><button class="btn gold" onclick="checkPuzzle()">${ch===0?'FILE EVIDENCE BOARD':ch===1?'PRINT CORRECTED CAPTIONS':ch===2?'TEST THE MANUAL':'SIGN FUNDING PLAN'}</button>${ch===2?'<button class="btn ghost" onclick="resetOrder(2)">RESTART SEQUENCE</button>':ch===3?'<button class="btn ghost" onclick="clearBudget()">CLEAR FUNDING</button>':''}</div>`;
 if(ch===0){const st=S.puzzleState[ch]||[];
  return `<section class="v32-puzzle v32-caseboard"><div class="v32-casehead"><small>GARDEN ENTRY · CASE REVIEW</small><h3>Sort the mayor's claims</h3><p>Place each statement in the folder it belongs to. The council will not authorize a report based only on a promise.</p></div>
  ${P.items.map((it,i)=>`<div class="v32-claimcard"><div class="v32-file-number">EXHIBIT ${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}</div><p>${esc(it[0])}</p><div class="v32-trays">${P.options.map(o=>`<button class="v32-file-option ${st[i]===o?'selected':''}" onclick="v32FileClaim(${ch},${i},'${o}')" aria-pressed="${st[i]===o}">${esc(o)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')}
  <div class="v32-evidence-cue">Remember: the <b>65 cm</b> gate is a documented measurement. “Every resident benefits” is a claim until evidence supports it.</div>${submit}</section>`;
 }
 if(ch===1){const st=S.puzzleState[ch]||[];
  return `<section class="v32-puzzle v32-captiondesk"><div class="v32-casehead"><small>MUNICIPAL IMAGE ARCHIVE / EDITING DESK</small><h3>Repair the public captions</h3><p>The work record and tourist brochure disagree. Choose only captions that the original record can support.</p></div><div class="v32-recordscene"><img src="${asset('town_2.webp')}" alt="The riverbank footbridge and floodwater after construction"><div><b>2022 → 2025</b><span>AN ORIGINAL DATE IS NOT AN OUTCOME MEASUREMENT</span></div></div>
  ${P.items.map((it,i)=>`<div class="v32-caption-row"><div class="v32-file-number">CORRECTION ${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')} / ${esc(it[0])}</div><div class="v32-caption-options">${it[1].map((o,j)=>`<button class="v32-caption-option ${st[i]===o?'selected':''}" onclick="v32FileClaim(${ch},${i},${j}===0?GAME.chapters[${ch}].puzzle.items[${i}][1][0]:${j}===1?GAME.chapters[${ch}].puzzle.items[${i}][1][1]:GAME.chapters[${ch}].puzzle.items[${i}][1][2])"><span>${j+1}</span>${esc(o)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')}
  <div class="v32-evidence-cue">Use the passive to describe verified work: <i>“A concrete wall was built.”</i> Do not report unmeasured flood reduction as proof.</div>${submit}</section>`;

 if(ch===2){const st=S.puzzleState[ch];
  return `<section class="v32-puzzle v32-workshopmanual"><div class="v32-casehead"><small>ABANDONED WORKSHOP / TRAINER'S MANUAL</small><h3>Teach it so you can leave</h3><p>Reconstruct the paper-bridge procedure. Choose an instruction strip below.</p>'}</div><div><h4>LOOSE INSTRUCTION STRIPS</h4>${st.pool.map((v,i)=>`<button class="v32-instruction-strip" onclick="addStep(2,${i})">+ ${esc(v)}</button>`).join('')||'<p class="muted">All four steps are in the manual.</p>'}</div></div><div class="v32-evidence-cue">Correct order matters: prepare → assemble → test → teach. Explain <i>why</i> this approach empowers residents.</div>${submit}</section>`;
 }
 if(ch===3){const st=S.puzzleState[ch]||[];
  return `<section class="v32-puzzle v32-counciltable"><div class="v32-casehead"><small>THE VACANT COUNCIL / TONIGHT'S PUBLIC SESSION</small><h3>Two grants. Three needs.</h3><p>Fund exactly two improvements. The third need must remain visible in your final letter, with a temporary response.</p></div><div class="v32-fundslots"><div class="${st[0]?'filled':''}">GRANT A <strong>${st[0]?esc(P.items.find(x=>x.id===st[0])?.text||''):'AVAILABLE'}</strong></div><div class="${st[1]?'filled':''}">GRANT B <strong>${st[1]?esc(P.items.find(x=>x.id===st[1])?.text||''):'AVAILABLE'}</strong></div></div><div class="v32-petitionlist">${P.items.map(it=>`<button class="v32-petition ${st.includes(it.id)?'approved':''}" onclick="toggleBudget('${it.id}')"><small>RESIDENT PETITION</small><b>${esc(it.text)}</b><span>${st.includes(it.id)?'✓ FUNDED':'NOT FUNDED'}</span></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="v32-evidence-cue">A bottom-up plan begins with residents.  }
 return v32PreviousPuzzleHTML();

/* Final-draft maintenance patch: preserve writing focus and assessment input. */
function fdUpdateWriting(ch){
 const ta=document.getElementById('writer');if(!ta)return;
 const d=ta.value; S.draft[ch]=d; persist();
 const W=GAME.chapters[ch].writing, c=S.cites[ch]||[];
 const wordCountNow=wordCount(d);
 const metricEls=document.querySelectorAll('.writerPanel .kv span');
 if(metricEls[0])metricEls[0].textContent=wordCountNow+' words';
 const criteria=document.querySelectorAll('.criteriaList .criterionCard');
 const tests=[[wordCountNow>=W.min,wordCountNow+' / '+W.min+'+ words'],[c.length>=2,c.length+' selected']];
 for(const [label,pattern] of W.required)tests.push([(new RegExp(pattern,'i')).test(d),(new RegExp(pattern,'i')).test(d)?'Present':'Missing']);
 tests.forEach(([ok,description],i)=>{const el=criteria[i];if(!el)return;el.classList.toggle('ok',ok);el.classList.toggle('bad',!ok);const status=el.querySelector('.status');if(status)status.textContent=ok?'ready':'revise';const p=el.querySelector('p');if(p)p.textContent=description;});
}
</script><script>

  ],

    {name:'Reception',kind:'reception',glows:[[.08,.12,.15,'warm',.22],[.37,.40,.17,'blue',.21]],screen:[[.38,.42,.15,.15,'blue',.20]],rain:[[.73,.03,.98,.58,.20]],mist:[.65,.47,.033],motes:16},
    {name:'Corridor',kind:'corridor',glows:[[.77,.38,.12,'red',.28],[.38,.70,.16,'warm',.16]],rain:[[.01,.06,.41,.72,.23]],water:[[.47,.86,.43,.10,.14]],mist:[.58,.62,.08],motes:11},
    {name:'Vault',kind:'vault',glows:[[.30,.34,.29,'blue',.20],[.80,.41,.12,'warm',.16]],screen:[[.35,.72,.32,.12,'warm',.13]],rain:[[.05,.12,.45,.69,.15]],mist:[.42,.47,.07],motes:14},
    {name:'Editing suite',kind:'editing',glows:[[.34,.43,.27,'blue',.24],[.59,.17,.20,'red',.09]],screen:[[.27,.42,.32,.24,'blue',.18]],mist:[.4,.46,.018],motes:9},
    {name:'Interview',kind:'interview',glows:[[.43,.30,.25,'blue',.12],[.62,.24,.13,'warm',.13]],screen:[[.42,.33,.27,.13,'blue',.12]],mist:[.5,.50,.023],motes:8},
    {name:'Applicants',kind:'applicants',glows:[[.25,.55,.17,'blue',.17],[.61,.30,.14,'warm',.10]],screen:[[.27,.50,.25,.20,'blue',.15]],mist:[.5,.50,.017],motes:8},
    {name:'Newsroom',kind:'newsroom',glows:[[.46,.32,.18,'blue',.17],[.69,.66,.18,'red',.13]],screen:[[.42,.28,.24,.17,'blue',.18]],mist:[.5,.40,.029],motes:11},
    {name:'Ethics committee',kind:'ethics',glows:[[.25,.38,.23,'blue',.19],[.53,.46,.12,'warm',.08]],screen:[[.21,.65,.31,.13,'warm',.14]],rain:[[.01,.10,.40,.53,.17]],mist:[.38,.54,.037],motes:15},
    {name:'Transmission roof',kind:'roof',glows:[[.80,.18,.12,'red',.28],[.28,.64,.18,'blue',.10]],rain:[[0,0,1,1,.44]],mist:[.66,.60,.10],motes:6}

const palette={warm:[255,180,89],blue:[107,204,239],red:[250,74,88]};

function fadeLight(x,y,r,color,opacity){const [xx,yy]=sourceCoord(x,y);const rad=r*drawW;
 const col=palette[color]||palette.blue, g=ctx.createRadialGradient(xx,yy,0,xx,yy,rad);
 g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(${col.join(',')},${Math.min(.55,opacity)})`);g.addColorStop(.12,`rgba(${col.join(',')},${opacity*.36})`);g.addColorStop(.52,`rgba(${col.join(',')},${opacity*.10})`);g.addColorStop(1,`rgba(${col.join(',')},0)`);

 const W=Math.max(1,Math.round(b.width)),H=Math.max(1,Math.round(b.height));
 can.width=Math.round(W*dpr);can.height=Math.round(H*dpr);can.style.width=W+'px';can.style.height=H+'px';
 ctx=can.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
 const iw=img&&img.naturalWidth||1536,ih=img&&img.naturalHeight||864;
 scale=Math.max(W/iw,H/ih)*1.018; drawW=iw*scale;drawH=ih*scale;offX=(W-drawW)/2;offY=(H-drawH)/2;
}
function reseed(){particles=Array.from({length:room.motes||12},(_,i)=>({x:Math.random(),y:Math.random(),speed:rand(.006,.019),alpha:rand(.07,.22),r:rand(.6,1.8),phase:rand(0,7)}));
 rain=[];for(const zone of room.rain||[]){const n=Math.max(6,Math.round(zone[4]*85)); for(let i=0;i<n;i++)rain.push({z:zone,x:rand(zone[0],zone[2]),y:rand(zone[1],zone[3]),speed:rand(.18,.34),length:rand(.008,.026),opacity:rand(.035,.13)});}}
function mist(now){if(!room.mist)return;const [cx,cy,str]=room.mist;const [x,y]=sourceCoord(cx+Math.sin(now*.08)*.035,cy+Math.cos(now*.11)*.011);const r=Math.max(drawW*.40,drawH*.30);
 const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(170,214,225,${str*(.7+.25*Math.sin(now*.19))})`);g.addColorStop(.6,`rgba(168,212,220,${str*.2})`);g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(170,210,223,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2);}
function lights(now){for(let i=0;i<(room.glows||[]).length;i++){let [x,y,r,color,str]=room.glows[i];let wave=.86+.08*Math.sin(now*(.7+i*.38)+i*2.1)+.06*Math.sin(now*(2.8+i*.5));
 if(game==='voice'&&(color==='red'||room.kind==='editing')&&Math.sin(now*.84+i*.8)>.985)wave*=.26;
 if(game==='town'&&room.kind==='garden'&&S.ng&&S.ng.actions&&S.ng.actions.gate)wave*=1.07;
 fadeLight(x,y,r,color,str*wave);}}
function water(now){for(const [x,y,rx,ry,str] of room.water||[]){const [cx,cy]=sourceCoord(x,y),rw=rx*drawW,rh=ry*drawH;
 ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,cy,Math.abs(rw),Math.abs(rh),0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.clip();
 for(let i=0;i<18;i++){const yy=cy+Math.sin(i*2.1)*rh*.84,px=cx+Math.sin(i*1.7+now*.42)*rw*.67;

 ctx.restore();}}
function rainStroke(now){for(const p of rain){let [x1,y1,x2,y2,str]=p.z;const zoneH=y2-y1;
 p.y+=dt*p.speed;if(p.y>y2+.025){p.y=y1-.01;p.x=rand(x1,x2)}
 const [x,y]=sourceCoord(p.x,p.y);const len=p.length*drawH;
 const drift=game==='voice'&&room.kind==='roof'?.24:.15;
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y);ctx.lineTo(x-drift*len,y+len);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(190,218,240,${p.opacity*(str+.37)})`;ctx.lineWidth=.55;ctx.stroke();}}

function screens(now){for(const [x,y,w,h,color,str] of room.screen||[]){const [xx,yy]=sourceCoord(x,y),ww=w*drawW,hh=h*drawH;
 const col=palette[color]||palette.blue;ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='screen';
 // An almost invisible data heartbeat, anchored to an existing display in the photograph.
 for(let k=0;k<11;k++){let bar=xx+(k/10-.5)*ww;const amplitude=(Math.sin(now*1.2+k*.68)+1)*.5;
 ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(${col.join(',')},${str*(.19+.20*amplitude)})`;
 ctx.fillRect(bar, yy+(1-amplitude)*hh*.25, Math.max(1,ww*.007), Math.max(2,hh*(.08+amplitude*.33)));}
 ctx.restore();}}
function leaves(now){if(!room.leaf)return;const [xx,yy,ww,hh]=room.leaf;ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
 const theta=now*(.28+i*.022)+i*1.8, x=xx+(i-3)*ww/8+Math.sin(theta)*.008, y=yy+Math.sin(i*1.55)*hh*.18;

function loop(ms){if(!on||!can)return;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 if(document.hidden||document.querySelector('.modal.open'))return;

function stop(){on=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;if(ro)ro.disconnect();ro=null;if(can)can.remove();can=null;ctx=null;img=null;vp=null;}
function install(){stop();document.querySelectorAll('.ambient-toggle').forEach(n=>n.remove());

All clues remain visible when motion is off.');
 b.innerHTML=`<span class="ambient-indicator"></span>${enabled()?'MOTION ON':'MOTION OFF'}`;
 b.addEventListener('click',()=>{S.sceneMotion=!enabled();persist();render();});
 buttons.insertBefore(b,buttons.querySelector('.btn.danger'));
 const focus=document.createElement('button');focus.className='btn slim ghost ambient-focus-toggle';focus.type='button';focus.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(!!S.sceneFocus));focus.textContent=S.sceneFocus?'EXIT FOCUS':'FOCUS VIEW';focus.setAttribute('aria-label','Toggle full-scene presentation view');focus.addEventListener('click',()=>{S.sceneFocus=!S.sceneFocus;persist();render()});
 buttons.insertBefore(focus,buttons.querySelector('.btn.danger'));}

 if(!enabled()||S.view!=='scene')return;

 room=(rooms[game]||rooms.town)[S.currentScene];if(!room)return;
 can=document.createElement('canvas');can.className='ambient-film';can.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');can.setAttribute('role','presentation');
 const ref=vp.querySelector('.viewportTop');vp.insertBefore(can,ref);

 const still=vp.querySelector('.sceneBg');if(still){still.style.setProperty('--par-x','0px');still.style.setProperty('--par-y','0px');}
 img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{if(can){resize();}};img.src=asset(sc.art);

}
const baseRender=render;
render=function(){stop();baseRender();install();};
const oldReset=typeof resetGame==='function'?resetGame:null;
if(oldReset){resetGame=function(){const was=S.sceneMotion;oldReset();if(was!==undefined){S.sceneMotion=was;persist();render()}};}
window.__EAL_AMBIENT__={version:'6.1.0',get active(){return on},get frames(){return ticks},get profile(){return room?room.name:null},get enabled(){return enabled()},enable(v){S.sceneMotion=!!v;persist();render()},focus(v){S.sceneFocus=!!v;persist();render()},stop};
